**Pull request #2131 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #2131: Patch: a co-op invite is a link, and a room link in chat joins in one press

Closes #2094

What changed and why: co-op invites are now clickable `/together?coop=<CODE>` links (R767's twin) instead of bare codes, and any chat message holding this origin's `/play?room=` or `/together?coop=` link draws a Join button while the message stays plain text.

- `apps/web/src/net/roomLink.ts`: new co-op helpers beside the room ones (`COOP_LINK_STORAGE_KEY`, `CoopRoomLink`, `coopLinkPath`/`coopLinkUrl`/`coopLinkOf`, `adoptCoopLink`/`readCoopLink`/`forgetCoopLink` mirroring the room-link pattern) plus `findRoomLinkInText`, which returns the first this-origin room link as an in-app path (normalised through `roomLinkPath`/`coopLinkPath`, pathname-checked per shape) and rejects other origins and malformed codes. `sendRoomLink` is reused unchanged.
- `apps/web/src/main.tsx`: `adoptCoopLink` runs at boot next to `adoptRoomLink`, so the code survives the sign-in trip per-tab.
- `apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.tsx`: reads the link once (join form prefilled, Join focused, forgotten after use), deck starts on last co-op pick (`COOP_DECK_KEY`) else first saved deck else random, room offers `duos-coop-link` share-or-copy ("Link shared"/"Link copied"), and the chat invite carries the link beside the code. Successful creates/joins remember the deck.
- `apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.tsx`: per message, a `chat-join` button built from the parsed link calls `navigate(path)`; the body element is byte-identical text, never markup.
- Testids (`duos-coop-link`, `chat-join`) mirrored in `e2e/support/testids.ts`; `apps/web/README.md` documents the link and ids.
- Spec: §13.9 invite sentence, §9.5 Chat and Co-op bullets, new ruling `spec/rulings/R2094000.md` (cites R767, R191, R264, R632), provenance in §11, `INDEX.md` regenerated by the tool.

How tested (commands run, output seen): `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run` on all five touched files — roomLink 18, CoopPanel 32, ChatPanel 26, TogetherRoute + shell-gate 75 tests, all passing, including the new `R2094000` cases (prefill/focus/forget, deck order, copy-link clipboard and share sheet, invite text, link join posting `/api/duos/rooms/<code>/join`, Join shown/hidden/navigate, unchanged message text, signed-out link kept through sign-in and used once); `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` clean; `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` clean; `cargo fmt --check` clean; `cargo jackioh spec check` ok (1316 rulings, 2987 proofs, 42163 citations).

Decisions not settled by the issue: `findRoomLinkInText` normalises to `roomLinkPath`/`coopLinkPath` and only accepts room links on `/play` and co-op links on `/together` (rejected: preserving raw query strings or cross-path params); same-path chat Join uses plain `navigate` per the issue text, matching the plan. One required follow-on: the new deck default (first saved deck) changed four pre-existing R2031000 lean-picker tests' implicit Random precondition, so they now pick the Random deck explicitly via a `chooseRandomDeck` helper and prove the same lean behaviour — no assertions weakened.

Reviewer look-twice: the `CoopRoomLink` type is exported for symmetry though only the code string is stored; the first-saved-deck default intentionally changes prior Random-first behaviour per the issue's acceptance list.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 3.

Notes the reviewer left (not blocking):

- `apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.tsx:160`: Same-path chat Join changes the URL but does not refill the already-mounted join form.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 98.1 min | green | approve |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 8s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 1s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 3s |

</details>

---
Built overnight by @jgoetzmann-bot ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40559028349)); every run on it, step by step, is in its [journal](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/bot-journal/2094.md). Comment `@jgoetzmann-bot <what to change>` or `/harness revise <notes>` to ask for a revision, or `/harness stop` to stop it.
```

The friend then has to open Play together, find the co-op panel, type the code and press Join. SPEC §13.9 says it the same way: "The host invites a friend by sending the code in chat". This patch makes an invite something to click. It touches only `apps/web`, plus the spec and `e2e/support/testids.ts`. **1. A co-op room link.** `/together?coop=` is R767's twin for a co-op room. - At boot, a valid code (R191's `canonicalCode` with `ROOM_CODE_FORMAT`) leaves the URL for per-tab storage, as `adoptRoomLink` does for `/play` (R632). It is kept through sign-in (B35). An invalid code is dropped. - Play together then opens with the co-op panel's join form filled with the code and Join focused. - The join form's deck choice starts on the player's last co-op pick, else their first saved deck, else a random deal. So joining from a link is one press. - The server still decides (CLAUDE.md rule 7): an unknown, full or blocked code is refused in the server's words, as today. - Put the link helpers beside `roomLinkPath` and `roomLinkOf` in `net/roomLink.ts`, or in a sibling module, and reuse `sendRoomLink` for sharing. **2. A room link in chat draws a Join button.** - A message whose text holds a room link of this site draws a Join button (`chat-join`) under the text. A room link is this origin's `/play?room=…` (as `roomLinkOf` reads it) or `/together?coop=…`. - The button opens the link inside the app (`navigate`, no reload), and the link is adopted as if it had been opened. - The message itself is still drawn as text, never as markup: the button is built from the parsed link, not from the message.
